summary: On paper this one is close: the Jets's best edge is to make them throw (The Jets' defense ranks 17th in EPA per dropback, +0.03 allowed). Under center, Geno Smith ranks 18th of 26 in EPA per dropback; x-factor: Garrett Wilson gets 29% of the Jets' targets and 35% of its air yards, and Miami's pass defense ranks 27th. The model favors Miami at 52%, mostly on rushing matchup (2.0 pts) and rest (0.8 pts).
